## Executive Summary

GIZ has published tender 10050309 for local consultancy support to Moldova's post-amalgamation institutional integration of local authorities. The page requires public-administration and Moldova experience, a multidisciplinary team and financial offers in Moldovan lei. Offers are due 5 October 2026 at 17:00 Chişinău time. The detailed TOR is available only by email request.

## Detailed Assignment Summary

The visible announcement describes the assignment as development and application of practical thematic guides for integrating local public authorities after amalgamation. It lists required company experience in reform, institutional development, finance, legal methods and workshops. The team must include a public-administration leader, a legal and regulatory expert, and two pools covering local governance, public finance, assets and service delivery. The page provides no public TOR text, detailed deliverable list, assignment duration or budget.

## Key Deliverables

- Thematic practical guides and their application; detailed outputs COULDN'T BE FOUND.

## Capacity Building Components

- The firm's required experience includes organization of capacity-development activities and workshops; specific activities for this contract COULDN'T BE FOUND.

## Team Requirements

Local company or consortium; Moldovan registration certificate required for the company or consortium lead. Team leader: relevant master's degree, C2 Romanian, C1 English and 10 years' public-administration/advisory experience. Legal expert: law master's degree, C2 Romanian, B2 English and 10 years' legal-advisory experience. Two expert pools require relevant master's degrees, Romanian/English proficiency and public-sector expertise.

## Strategic Notes For FS

- The page names public-sector institutional development and methodological guidance.
- Local registration and Romanian-language requirements shape eligibility.

## Risks / Concerns

- Local provider requirement and Moldovan registration for the lead.
- C2 Romanian required for the named experts.
- TOR and assessment grid require an email request; budget and duration are COULDN'T BE FOUND.
